access_forbidden_role: Your role ({role}) does not allow this: {needed} is needed
access_login_required: You need to identify yourself with your name and PIN
access_service_unreachable: WorkshopService cannot be asked who you are: try again in a moment
bus_corrupt_answer_from_address: corrupt answer from address {address} (CRC or length)
bus_could_not_configure_the_duet_port: could not configure the Duet port: {error}
bus_no_answer_from_address_duet: no answer from address {address} (through the Duet)
bus_pyserial_is_missing: pyserial is missing in the plugin environment
bus_the_bus_did_not_answer_in_time: the bus did not answer in time (queue full or port hung)
bus_the_dsf_user_needs_the_dialout_group: {error} -- the dsf user needs the dialout group (see the RS485 page)
detection_done_no_new_device: Done: no new device showed up.
detection_new_device_added_by_itself: new device added by itself: {name} on {bus} ({format}), without an axis. Check it on the RS485 page.
detection_that_adapter_is_not_free: that adapter is not free (a bus already uses it) or it is not connected
detection_that_device_is_no_longer_detec: that device is no longer in the detected list
detection_there_is_already_a_device_at: there is already a device at that address
diagnosis_a_sweep_is_already_running: a sweep is already running: cancel it or wait until it ends
generic_at_most_registers_at_a_time: at most {n} registers at a time
generic_profile_description: Any Modbus RTU device (drive, meter, sensor, another servo): you choose which registers to read.
generic_register_marked_read_only: Register {register} is marked as read only
generic_register_not_in_the_profile: register {register} is not in the device profile
generic_register_read_only_in_the_profil: Register {register} ({name}) is read only in the device profile
generic_to_must_not_be_less_than_from: 'to' must be greater than or equal to 'from'
generic_value_does_not_fit_16_bits: {value} does not fit in a 16-bit register
main_a_detection_is_running: a detection is running: wait until it ends
main_home_cancelled_axis_in_fault: RS485: home cancelled: {name} (axis {axis}) is in fault: {fault}. Fix the fault and try again.
main_no_such_device: no such device (or its bus/profile does not exist)
main_that_adapter_is_used_by_a_bus: a bus already uses that adapter: search on the bus
main_two_devices_with_the_same_id: there are two devices with the same id
profile_json_alarm_is_not_an_object: alarm {n}: it is not an object
profile_json_alarm_table_without_registe: there is an alarm table but no 'alarm.register' (where the code is read): the alarms are shown but not watched
profile_json_device_is_not_an_object: 'device' is not an object: it is ignored
profile_json_input_registers_are_not_wri: parameter {register}: input registers (function 4) are not written: it stays read only
profile_json_parameter_is_not_an_object: parameter {n}: it is not an object
profile_json_parity_is_not_n_e_o: device: parity '{parity}' is not N, E or O
profile_json_peak_torque_help: Torque peak since the last clearing.
profile_json_t3d_export_notes: Exported from the T3D Servo profile. On the drive: P-181 address, P-182 baud rate, P-183 format; they must match the bus. Source: T3D Full manual V2.3.
profile_json_the_profile_must_be_an_obje: the profile must be a JSON object
profile_json_torque_help: Current torque in % of the rated one. Above the maximum it is treated as a jam.
profiles_fault_live_job_cannot_be_paused: {text} -- live job: it cannot be paused from the machine, pause it in the program that sends it
t3d_alarms_abnormal_detection_encoder_z_: Abnormal detection of the encoder Z signal
t3d_alarms_absolute_encoder_battery_has_: The absolute encoder battery has low voltage.
t3d_alarms_ad_sampling_amplifier_circuit: The AD sampling amplifier circuit is abnormal.
t3d_alarms_ad_sampling_reference_voltage: The AD sampling reference voltage is out of range.
t3d_alarms_average_motor_current_too_hig: The average motor current is too high for a long time.
t3d_alarms_braking_energy_too_high_short: The braking energy is too high for a short time.
t3d_alarms_check_braking_resistor_not_da: Check that the braking resistor is not damaged and that terminals P and D are connected.
t3d_alarms_check_braking_resistor_termin: Check the braking resistor and terminals P and D; make the decelerations smoother.
t3d_alarms_check_encoder_cable_connector: Check the encoder cable and connectors; if they are fine, the encoder or the servo interface is damaged.
t3d_alarms_check_encoder_cable_loose_dis: Check the encoder cable (loose or disconnected, at the servo and at the motor), the shield to ground, interference from nearby power cables, or a damaged encoder. Then turn the servo off and on.
t3d_alarms_check_encoder_cable_restart_s: Check the encoder cable and restart the servo.
t3d_alarms_check_encoder_wiring_shield_i: Check the encoder wiring (shield included) and that there are no broken wires.
t3d_alarms_check_interference_encoder_ca: Check interference on the encoder cable (shield to ground, apart from the power cables) and the connectors.
t3d_alarms_check_jams_excessive_load_adj: Check jams or excessive load, or adjust P-070, P-071 and P-072.
t3d_alarms_check_mechanical_jams_gains_p: Check mechanical jams, gains (P-005 / P-009), very abrupt accelerations or a P-080 that is too small.
t3d_alarms_check_motor_code_correct_moto: Check that the motor code is correct and that the motor has that type of encoder.
t3d_alarms_check_p_075_maximum_speed: Check P-075 (maximum speed) and the speed command / pulse frequency.
t3d_alarms_check_p_099_series_p: Check P-099 (series) and P-002 (model) against the motor nameplate.
t3d_alarms_check_polarity_encoder_batter: Check the polarity of the encoder battery, restart the servo and set the machine zero again.
t3d_alarms_check_power_supply_cables_bre: Check the power supply (cables, breaker, mains voltage).
t3d_alarms_check_replace_battery_3_6: Check / replace the battery (3.6 V), clear the alarm with the procedure and set the machine zero again.
t3d_alarms_check_short_circuits_motor_wi: Check for short circuits in the motor wiring, gains that are too high or a mechanical impact.
t3d_alarms_check_short_circuits_u_v: Check for short circuits in U/V/W and in the motor. If it continues with the motor disconnected, the servo is damaged.
t3d_alarms_check_speed_steps_per_mm: Check the speed / steps per mm that the Duet sends and the electronic gear (P-028 to P-030).
t3d_alarms_check_u_v_w_power: Check the U/V/W power cables (loose contact), the motor code and that the load is not stuck.
t3d_alarms_cleared_here_once_cause_remov: It is cleared from here once the cause is removed.
t3d_alarms_cleared_special_procedure_ser: It is cleared with a special procedure on the servo.
t3d_alarms_command_pulses_arrive_faster_: The command pulses arrive faster than the servo accepts.
t3d_alarms_dc_bus_voltage_too_high: The DC bus voltage is too high (regenerative braking not dissipated).
t3d_alarms_difference_between_commanded_: The difference between the commanded and the real position exceeds P-080 (in 0.01 turns).
t3d_alarms_encoder_cable_loose_disconnec: Encoder cable loose or disconnected, or interference.
t3d_alarms_encoder_uvw_signals_have_impo: The encoder UVW signals have an impossible combination (manual V2.3).
t3d_alarms_encoder_z_signal_arrives_erro: The encoder Z signal arrives with errors (manual V2.3).
t3d_alarms_encoder_zero_must_calibrated_: The encoder zero must be calibrated with the manufacturer's software.
t3d_alarms_error_reading_writing_paramet: Error reading or writing the parameter memory (it was turned off while saving).
t3d_alarms_fault_processor_s_peripheral_: Fault in the processor's peripheral logic.
t3d_alarms_fault_servo_s_power_inverter: Fault in the servo's power inverter module.
t3d_alarms_fault_signal_wire_saving_enco: Fault in the signal of a wire-saving encoder (manual V2.3).
t3d_alarms_loss_encoder_z_signal: Loss of the encoder Z signal
t3d_alarms_main_supply_voltage_below_spe: The main supply voltage is below the specification.
t3d_alarms_motor_does_not_turn_although: The motor does not turn although it is commanded to (jam or power problem).
t3d_alarms_motor_load_exceeded_p_070: The motor load exceeded P-070 / P-071 for longer than P-072.
t3d_alarms_motor_not_calibrated_encoder_: The motor is not calibrated to the encoder zero.
t3d_alarms_motor_parameters_must_written: The motor parameters must be written and the zero calibrated with the manufacturer's software.
t3d_alarms_motor_speed_exceeds_maximum_a: The motor speed exceeds the maximum allowed.
t3d_alarms_new_battery_place_panel_fn: With the new battery in place: on the panel, Fn 0 (hold SET 3 s).
t3d_alarms_non_standard_motor_wrong_enco: Non-standard motor or wrong encoder zero.
t3d_alarms_normal_first_time_if_motor: It is normal the first time or if the motor encoder was unplugged; otherwise, low battery or a broken battery cable.
t3d_alarms_not_cleared_communication_rem: It is not cleared by communication: remove the cause and turn the servo off and on.
t3d_alarms_reduce_load_acceleration_chec: Reduce the load or the acceleration, check mechanical friction and that the brake (if any) releases.
t3d_alarms_reduce_load_duty_cycle_let: Reduce the load or the duty cycle and let the motor cool down.
t3d_alarms_replace_battery_servo_disable: Replace the battery with the servo on and disabled.
t3d_alarms_servo_cannot_talk_motor_encod: The servo cannot talk to the motor encoder.
t3d_alarms_servo_does_not_receive_encode: The servo does not receive the encoder Z signal (manual V2.3).
t3d_alarms_servo_panel_p_000_510: On the servo panel: P-000 = 510 (or 310), menu A-FN, Fn 0 (hold SET 3 s). Or P-008 = 2, save to EEPROM, turn off and on. Then set the machine zero again.
t3d_alarms_servo_s_instantaneous_current: The servo's instantaneous current is too high.
t3d_alarms_servo_s_internal_motor_code: The servo's internal motor code does not match the motor.
t3d_alarms_single_turn_position_was_clea: The single-turn position was cleared illegally.
t3d_alarms_turn_count_absolute_encoder_w: The turn count of the absolute encoder was lost.
t3d_alarms_turn_off_if_continues_restore: Turn it off and on. If it continues, restore the default parameters and load them again.
t3d_alarms_turn_off_if_continues_servo: Turn it off and on. If it continues, the servo needs technical service.
t3d_alarms_turn_off_set_machine_zero: Turn it off and on; set the machine zero again.
t3d_could_not_verify_parameter: Could not verify {param} = {value} (the drive returned {read}). It may be a read-only or protected parameter (P-000).
t3d_current_over_the_limit: current {current} A exceeds the limit {limit} A
t3d_es_1_turns_communication_off_servo: -1 turns the communication off: the servo stops answering over RS485.
t3d_es_brake_delay_motor_stopped: Brake delay with the motor stopped
t3d_es_brake_wait_motor_running: Brake wait with the motor running
t3d_es_digits_units_ccwl_cwl_limit: By digits: units = CCWL/CWL limit switches, tens = analog command. Each digit from 0 to 3 (0 uses both, 1 ignores CCWL, 2 ignores CWL, 3 ignores both).
t3d_es_drive_stores_tenths_degree_e: The drive stores it in tenths of a degree (e.g. -1800 = -180.0°).
t3d_es_exponential_smoothing_pulse_comma: Exponential smoothing of the pulse command
t3d_es_higher_less_following_error_too: Higher = less following error; too high = it overshoots.
t3d_es_higher_responds_faster_too_high: Higher = responds faster; too high = it vibrates.
t3d_es_password_unlock_p_001_p: Password to unlock P-001 / P-002 / P-099
t3d_es_protected_password_must_set_p: Protected: the password must be set in P-000 to change it. With an absolute encoder the drive takes it from the motor.
t3d_es_some_protected_parameters_can_onl: Some protected parameters can only be changed with the password set.
t3d_es_speed_limit_error_torque_control: Speed limit error in torque control
t3d_es_summary_manual_v2_3_says: The summary of manual V2.3 says 0~3, but the detail documents up to 5 (115200).
t3d_es_time_trigger_overload_alarm: Time to trigger the overload alarm
t3d_es_turn_off_enable_alarm: Turn off the enable on an alarm
t3d_es_use_travel_limits_positive_negati: Use of the travel limits (positive / negative)
t3d_group_acceleration_speed_and_torque_: Ramps, maximum speed and overload protections.
t3d_group_analog_inputs_help: Only if it is controlled by an analog voltage.
t3d_group_control_mode_help: Position, speed or torque, and where the commands come from.
t3d_group_digital_inputs_and_outputs_hel: Function of each DI / DO terminal and forced ones.
t3d_group_drive_motor_and_encoder_help: Drive model, motor and encoder data; normally they are not touched.
t3d_group_encoder_output_and_absolute_po: Pulses the servo sends back out.
t3d_group_gains_and_filters_help: Servo response: more gain = stiffer, too much = it vibrates.
t3d_group_internal_speeds_and_torques_he: Fixed values chosen with the digital inputs.
t3d_group_positioning_arrival_and_brake_: Windows of 'arrived', zero speed and brake.
t3d_group_pulses_and_electronic_gear_hel: How the steps the Duet sends are interpreted.
t3d_group_rs485_communication_help: Address, speed and format. If you change them, change the bus too or the connection is lost.
t3d_help_2nd_gear_numerator_chosen_gear1: 2nd gear numerator, chosen with the GEAR1/GEAR2 inputs. Without those inputs it is not used.
t3d_help_3rd_gear_numerator_chosen_gear1: 3rd gear numerator, chosen with the GEAR1/GEAR2 inputs.
t3d_help_4th_gear_numerator_chosen_gear1: 4th gear numerator, chosen with the GEAR1/GEAR2 inputs.
t3d_help_acceleration_ramp_speed_mode_ms: Acceleration ramp in speed mode: ms to go from 0 to 1000 rpm. In position mode the Duet makes the ramp.
t3d_help_activates_inputs_software_witho: Activates inputs by software without wiring them (each bit is a function). Useful to enable the servo without a SON wire.
t3d_help_address_servo_rs485_bus_1: Address of the servo on the RS485 bus (1 to 32). -1 turns the communication off: afterwards it can only be recovered from the panel.
t3d_help_advances_speed_command_accordin: Advances the speed command according to the incoming pulses, to reduce the delay when following the position. 0 = off.
t3d_help_below_speed_counts_stopped_hand: Below this speed it counts as stopped to handle the brake.
t3d_help_below_speed_servo_considers_mot: Below this speed the servo considers the motor stopped (ZSP output).
t3d_help_change_only_knowing_what_does: Change only knowing what it does
t3d_help_change_password_must_first_set: To change it the password must first be set in P-000.
t3d_help_changes_which_way_motor_turns: Changes which way the motor turns or counts.
t3d_help_clockwise_force_limit_when_tcw: Clockwise force limit when the TCW input is active.
t3d_help_code_motor_servo_thinks_has: Code of the motor the servo thinks it has. If it does not match the real motor, the servo does not control it well (Err25).
t3d_help_corrects_zero_analog_speed_inpu: Corrects the zero of the analog speed input (if the motor moves with 0 V).
t3d_help_corrects_zero_analog_torque_inp: Corrects the zero of the analog torque input.
t3d_help_counterclockwise_force_limit_wh: Counterclockwise force limit when the TCCW input is active.
t3d_help_deceleration_ramp_speed_mode_ms: Deceleration ramp in speed mode: ms to go from 1000 to 0 rpm.
t3d_help_denominator_electronic_gear_mot: Denominator of the electronic gear. Motor steps per pulse = numerator / P-030.
t3d_help_describes_connected_motor_encod: Describes the connected motor/encoder; with an absolute encoder the servo takes them by itself.
t3d_help_di_do_terminals_servo: DI / DO terminals of the servo.
t3d_help_electronic_gear_how_many_encode: Electronic gear: how many encoder steps each Duet pulse is worth (numerator = P-028 × 10000 + P-029). If you change it, the steps/mm of that axis in the Duet change.
t3d_help_enable_servo_always_1_only: Enable the servo always (1) or only when the SON input is active (0).
t3d_help_enables_changing_gear_while_run: Enables changing the gear while running; each digit is 0 or 1.
t3d_help_filters_noise_direction_signal: Filters noise on the direction signal.
t3d_help_filters_noise_pulse_signal_high: Filters noise on the pulse signal. Higher = more filtering, but it limits the maximum pulse frequency.
t3d_help_fine_adjustment_response_stiffe: Fine adjustment of the response: stiffer or softer.
t3d_help_fixed_speed_1_speed_mode: Fixed speed 1 (speed mode, chosen with SP1-SP3).
t3d_help_fixed_torque_1_torque_mode: Fixed torque 1 (torque mode, chosen with TRQ1/TRQ2).
t3d_help_forced_inputs_fifth_group_inclu: Forced inputs, fifth group (includes the CCWL/CWL limit switches).
t3d_help_forced_inputs_second_group_func: Forced inputs, second group of functions.
t3d_help_forced_inputs_third_group_funct: Forced inputs, third group of functions.
t3d_help_how_cle_input_clears_deviation: How the CLE input clears the deviation: while it is active (0) or only when it turns on (1).
t3d_help_how_far_motor_can_lag: How far the motor can lag behind the command (in 0.01 turns) before the Err4 alarm. It is the protection against jams or lost steps.
t3d_help_how_hard_servo_corrects_positio: How hard the servo corrects the position error. Higher = it follows the position better; too much = it overshoots and oscillates.
t3d_help_how_hard_servo_corrects_speed: How hard the servo corrects speed errors. Higher = stiffer and faster; too much = it vibrates or hums.
t3d_help_how_holds_still_zclamp_input: How it holds still with the ZCLAMP input in speed mode.
t3d_help_how_long_p_070_071: How long the P-070/071 overload must last to trigger Err29.
t3d_help_how_long_takes_brake_motor: How long it takes to brake the motor on an emergency stop or alarm. Very short = abrupt braking.
t3d_help_how_long_takes_correct_small: How long it takes to correct small speed errors that persist. Lower = it corrects faster but may oscillate.
t3d_help_how_long_waits_after_releasing: How long it waits after releasing the brake before moving the motor.
t3d_help_how_many_pulses_per_turn: How many pulses per turn the servo puts out on its encoder output.
t3d_help_how_many_rpm_each_volt: How many rpm for each volt of the analog speed input.
t3d_help_how_much_torque_each_volt: How much torque (%) for each volt of the analog torque input.
t3d_help_how_receives_commands_0_positio: How it receives the commands: 0 = position (pulses from the Duet, the normal one in a CNC), 1 = speed, 2 = torque, or mixed.
t3d_help_how_servo_interprets_steps_duet: How the servo interprets the steps the Duet sends: it affects the steps/mm.
t3d_help_how_stops_motor_emergency_stop: How it stops the motor on an emergency stop.
t3d_help_inverts_b_phases_encoder_output: Inverts the A/B phases of the encoder output.
t3d_help_inverts_direction_absolute_posi: Inverts the direction of the absolute position the servo sends out. It does not change the rotation of the motor.
t3d_help_inverts_direction_analog_speed_: Inverts the direction of the analog speed command.
t3d_help_inverts_direction_analog_torque: Inverts the direction of the analog torque command.
t3d_help_inverts_direction_rotation_duet: Inverts the direction of rotation for the Duet pulses. It is the way to invert the axis from the servo (or do it in the Duet with M569 S, not in both).
t3d_help_jog_speed_servo_panel: JOG speed from the servo panel.
t3d_help_limits_levels_motor_force: Limits or levels of the motor force.
t3d_help_low_part_electronic_gear_numera: Low part of the electronic gear numerator (see P-028).
t3d_help_margin_so_arrived_signal_does: Margin so that the 'arrived' signal does not flicker.
t3d_help_margin_speed_reached_signal: Margin of the speed reached signal.
t3d_help_margin_torque_reached_signal: Margin of the torque reached signal.
t3d_help_margin_zero_speed_signal: Margin of the zero speed signal.
t3d_help_maximum_force_can_make_turning: Maximum force it can make turning counterclockwise, in % of the rated one. Lowering it limits the force in a crash.
t3d_help_maximum_force_test_run_jog: Maximum force in the test run (JOG from the panel).
t3d_help_maximum_motor_speed_if_duet: Maximum motor speed. If the Duet asks for more, the servo limits itself (or gives Err1 overspeed).
t3d_help_motor_series_absolute_encoder_s: Motor series. With an absolute encoder the servo detects it.
t3d_help_motor_still_how_long_waits: With the motor still: how long it waits to cut the current after applying the brake (keeps the axis from falling).
t3d_help_motor_turning_how_long_waits: With the motor turning: how long it waits before applying the brake when disabling.
t3d_help_motor_turning_speed_below_which: With the motor turning: speed below which it applies the brake.
t3d_help_negative_dead_band_analog_input: Negative dead band of the analog input.
t3d_help_only_applies_after_turning_serv: It only applies after turning the servo off and on.
t3d_help_only_if_controlled_analog_volta: Only if it is controlled with an analog voltage (not your case with the Duet).
t3d_help_only_if_motor_has_electromagnet: Only if the motor has an electromagnetic brake.
t3d_help_operation_password_some_paramet: Operation password. Some parameters (drive code, motor code and motor series) can only be changed with 385 or 316 here; 510 enables special functions of the panel.
t3d_help_polarity_accepted_analog_speed_: Polarity accepted on the analog speed input.
t3d_help_polarity_accepted_analog_torque: Polarity accepted on the analog torque input.
t3d_help_polarity_z_signal_encoder_outpu: Polarity of the Z signal of the encoder output.
t3d_help_positive_dead_band_analog_input: Positive dead band of the analog input: smaller voltages are taken as 0.
t3d_help_protects_machine_limits_alarms_: Protects the machine: limits, alarms, stops.
t3d_help_rated_motor_current_tenths_ampe: Rated motor current in tenths of an ampere (48 = 4.8 A).
t3d_help_read_only_servo_reports: Read only: the servo reports it.
t3d_help_resolution_bits_23_bit_absolute: Resolution in bits of the 23-bit absolute encoder.
t3d_help_rs485_data_format_parity_stop: RS485 data format (parity and stop bits). It must match the bus.
t3d_help_rs485_if_does_not_match: RS485: if it does not match the bus, the connection is lost.
t3d_help_rs485_speed_0_4800_5: RS485 speed (0 = 4800 … 5 = 115200 baud). It must be the same as the bus.
t3d_help_scale_absolute_position_servo_s: Scale of the absolute position the servo sends (numerator).
Scale of the absolute position the servo sends (denominator).
t3d_help_servo_model_set_factory: Servo model. Set by the factory.
t3d_help_smooths_encoder_speed_measureme: Smooths the encoder speed measurement. Raising it reduces noise; too much adds delay.
t3d_help_smooths_feedforward_p_021_so: Smooths the feedforward of P-021 so that it does not cause jerks.
t3d_help_smooths_force_command_motor_rai: Smooths the force command to the motor. Raising it removes vibrations and noise; too much makes the response slow.
t3d_help_smooths_incoming_pulses_smoothe: Smooths the incoming pulses (smoother starts and stops). 0 = no smoothing; it adds delay.
t3d_help_smooths_signals_noise_safe_try: Smooths signals or noise; safe to try.
t3d_help_speed_which_speed_reached_turns: Speed from which 'speed reached' turns on (ASP output).
t3d_help_time_input_must_hold_taken: Time an input must hold to be taken as valid (avoids bounces and noise).
t3d_help_torque_mode_error_margin_speed: In torque mode: error margin of the speed limit.
t3d_help_torque_mode_maximum_allowed_spe: In torque mode: maximum allowed speed.
t3d_help_torque_mode_where_speed_limit: In torque mode: where the speed limit comes from.
t3d_help_torque_which_torque_reached_tur: Torque from which 'torque reached' turns on (ATRQ output).
t3d_help_version_servo_s_internal_progra: Version of the servo's internal program.
t3d_help_what_kind_signal_duet_sends: What kind of signal the Duet sends: 0 = pulse + direction (the normal one with the Duet), 1 = CW/CCW pulses, 2 = A/B quadrature.
t3d_help_what_output_do1_indicates_numbe: What output DO1 indicates. The number is the function; negative = inverted logic.
t3d_help_what_sustained_counterclockwise: At what % of sustained counterclockwise force the Err29 overload alarm trips (it detects jams).
t3d_help_what_terminal_di1_does_number: What terminal DI1 does. The number is the function; negative = inverted logic.
t3d_help_where_speed_command_comes_speed: Where the speed command comes from in speed mode. Not used in position mode.
t3d_help_where_torque_command_comes_torq: Where the torque command comes from in torque mode. Not used in position mode.
t3d_help_whether_alarm_turns_off_motor: Whether an alarm turns off the motor enable.
t3d_help_whether_servo_uses_its_own: Whether the servo uses its own limit switches (CCWL/CWL inputs). By digits: units = limit switches, tens = analog command; 3 = ignore. With the Duet the limit switches are handled by the Duet: the normal value is 33.
t3d_help_whether_speed_reached_counts_on: Whether the speed reached counts in one direction only or in both.
t3d_help_whether_torque_reached_counts_o: Whether the torque reached counts in one direction only or in both.
t3d_help_which_edge_signal_pulse_counts: On which edge of the signal a pulse counts. If it is wrong, the axis loses or doubles steps.
t3d_help_which_signal_goes_out_divided: Which signal goes out on the divided pulse output.
t3d_help_which_torque_limit_used_interna: Which torque limit is used: the internal one (P-065/066), the external one (P-067/068, with the TCCW/TCW inputs) or both.
t3d_help_width_z_pulse_encoder_output: Width of the Z pulse of the encoder output.
t3d_help_within_how_many_pulses_command: Within how many pulses of the command it counts as arrived (COIN output).
t3d_help_within_how_many_pulses_counts: Within how many pulses it counts as 'near' (NEAR output).
t3d_help_zero_angle_encoder_relative_mot: Zero angle of the encoder relative to the motor. Set wrong, the motor does not turn well or heats up.
t3d_parameter_is_read_only: {param} is read only: nothing was sent.
t3d_parameter_value_not_sent: {param} = {value}: {reason}. Nothing was sent (check the manual and tick 'force' to write it anyway).
t3d_params_absolute_encoder_initializati: Absolute encoder initialization (2 = clear Err35/40/41 on restart)
t3d_params_alarm_mask: Alarm mask (8 from the factory; 32 blocks Err5)
t3d_params_enables_clearing_the_alarm_hi: Enables clearing the alarm history of the panel (4)
t3d_params_gain_change_selection: Gain change selection (2 = by the GAIN input)
t3d_params_not_in_the_manual_table: it is not in the manual table
t3d_params_speed_regulator_structure: Speed regulator structure (0 = IP, 100 = PI, 1-99 = PDFF)
t3d_params_tens_the_same_for_the_analog: tens: the same for the analog speed command
t3d_params_units_limit_switches: units: CCWL / CWL limit switches (0 uses both, 1 ignores CCWL, 2 ignores CWL, 3 ignores both)
t3d_profile_description: T3D servo drive: live alarm, torque and current, pauses the job on a fault, P-xxx parameters.
t3d_states_0_if_encoder_not_multi: 0 if the encoder is not multi-turn.
t3d_states_bit_0_di1_bit_7: bit 0 = DI1 ... bit 7 = DI8; 1 = high level
t3d_states_bit_0_do1_bit_5: bit 0 = DO1 ... bit 5 = DO6; 1 = high level
t3d_states_rest_should_close_0: At rest it should be close to 0.
t3d_states_unit_not_given_manual_0: Unit not given in the manual; 0 = the servo does not report it.
t3d_states_unit_not_given_manual_1: Unit not given in the manual (≈ 1.41 × mains voltage).
